vacancies.title: Commercialization Engineer
vacancies.assessment: ESTEC role requiring a technical MSc; less hardware-focused.

vacancies.title: Product Assurance & Safety Support Engineer
vacancies.assessment: Official detail page has an invalid last-apply date ('28/20/2026'). The official overview appears to display a rolling date exactly six months ahead (20 April on 20 October; 22 April on 22 October; 23 April on 23 October), not a verified fixed closing date. Deadline is therefore unknown until explicitly confirmed. Senior PA&S role supporting ESA manufacturing, inspection, AIT and nonconformance activities; requires 10 years space-sector experience including 5 years PA/QA.

vacancies.title: Configuration & Data Manager
vacancies.assessment: Direct Noordwijk role; dedicated configuration/data-management experience is a significant stretch.

vacancies.title: Mechanisms Engineer
vacancies.assessment: Direct ESTEC mechanisms support covering spacecraft hardware design reviews, manufacturing, testing, CDF studies and NCRs. Strong mechanical fit; requires 4 years of specific space-mechanisms experience, so a stretch.

vacancies.title: Programme / Project Controller
vacancies.assessment: ESA programme-control role with industrial procurement, budgeting and schedule oversight. Relevant to project management but financially focused and requires prior aerospace project-control experience.

vacancies.title: Configuration and Document Management Officer - 3 Months Project
vacancies.assessment: Noordwijk configuration and document management, limited 3-month project at 3–4 days/week; under-level and unlikely to meet full-time salary target.

vacancies.title: Configuration and Document Officer - 6 Months Project
vacancies.assessment: Noordwijk configuration/document management for a 6-month assignment. The newer official Sopra Steria/HE Space job page says 6 months and last apply date 31 Dec 2026, whereas the legacy HE Space page still says 3 months and 31 Oct 2026. Source discrepancy flagged. Administrative-heavy and likely below engineering/salary target.

vacancies.title: Electromechanical Engineer for Test Facility - Temporary
vacancies.assessment: Direct ESTEC environmental Test Centre engineering: improve and develop TVAC/vibration/acoustic/shock/EMC test facilities, support calibration, maintenance and spacecraft test campaigns. MSc and >=4 years relevant experience required; strong transferable mechanical/test-facility experience but explicit space environmental-test experience is a gap. Temporary contract; official detailed page states last apply 15 November 2026 (overview lists 16 November). Distinct HE Space requisition 26190, not ATG or Akkodis.
